1. **Kinematics & Servo Offset Handling:**
   - On 2026-11-04, the right follower arm underwent servo replacement (shoulder and wrist) following an overload fault, leaving forward Cartesian kinematics offset by several millimeters prior to scheduled physical recalibration.
